# Disabled on 2026-09-22

Both workflows were moved out of `.github/workflows/` at the repo owner's
instruction after cults3d.com blocked his home IP for scraping.

GitHub only executes files inside `.github/workflows/`, so nothing here can
run, be scheduled, or be dispatched. Re-enabling is a deliberate `git mv` back
— not an accident.

Do not restore these without the owner's explicit say-so.
